actual_hs_list: 3919.90 (self-adhesive plastic film in rolls — vinyl wrap / PPF / window film base: plausible)
3920.62 (other plastic film, PET-based, for window film / PPF top layer — possible alternative)
3921.90 (other plastic sheets/films, laminated — possible for multi-layer PPF)
8205.59 / 8211.93 (hand tools, knives, squeegees, scrapers — separate line, not covered by 3919)
product_summary: Website teckwrap.in (Gurugram, Sector 65, Haryana; sales@teckwrap.in) presents itself as 'TeckWrap India — Authorized Distributor of TeckWrap in India'. Real catalogue lines published on the site: (1) Vehicle wraps — Gloss (102 SKU), Matte (18), Satin (50), Chrome (14), Color Shift (21), Structure (7) vinyl wraps; (2) Paint Protection Film — Clear PPF (17) and Color PPF (34); (3) Window Film (30 SKU: TWF70, I20-2.5mil, Ionix I15, Ceramic C15/C30/C70, Aegis Double Silver W15/W30/W70S, Vita Skin Care SC15); (4) Tools (17 SKU: safety cutter, rubber squeegees, polyurethane scrapers, 9mm utility knife TW-UK-04, buffer 10-pcs, installation master sets); (5) PPF installation liquid. Also 'print media' / printable film and headlight tint are named in the About Us text. All prices are hidden behind login ('Login to see price'), i.e. B2B/wholesale model. No customs line, invoice or shipping document is published on the site, so the physical composition (PVC calendered vs. polymeric vs. PET/TPU) of each line is заявлено, не подтверждено.
role_hint: trader / distributor (authorized importer-distributor of the TeckWrap brand for India; the brand's own manufacturing is stated to be at an ISO-certified facility abroad with warehouses in USA and China — teckwrap.in itself does not claim to be the producer). Trader status is not a rejection ground.
comment: HS 391990 is directionally correct for the core line (self-adhesive plastic film in rolls: vinyl wraps, PPF, window tint) — hence 'partial', not 'wrong'. However the declared single code does not cover the whole declared product range: (a) tools/knives/squeegees/scrapers (Ch. 82) and PPF installation liquid (Ch. 34/38) are separate commodity lines and are missing from the declaration; (b) window film and multi-layer PPF may fall under 3920.62/3921.90 depending on substrate and lamination — needs the actual TDS/composition to fix at 6-digit level; (c) 'print media / printable film' is named on the site but has no SKU page, so it is заявлено, не подтверждено. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is an automotive aftermarket / films & detailing supplies distributor (plastics film + tools), not oil & gas. Per rule 3 the company is kept and the code is corrected, not rejected. No customs line was available to me in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration of any HS code — all product mapping is based on the public catalogue only. Legal entity name 'GOVIND SINGH JADAUN' is not confirmed anywhere on teckwrap.in (site shows only brand name, Gurugram address and phone numbers); PAN and state of registration not public on the site — null.
